languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Destroy robots: their wreckage becomes climbable scrap.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Destrueix robots: les seves restes es converteixen en ferralla escalable.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Uneven scrap attracts bulky junk.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>La ferralla desnivellada atrau càrregues grans.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green>Build and climb onto settled scrap at %1 m.</green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green>Construeix i puja sobre ferralla assentada a %1 m.</green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green>Scrap</green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green>Ferralla</green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Target</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Objectiu</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Wave</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Onada</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Incoming junk! It will settle into a low part of the heap.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Arriba ferralla! S'assentarà en una zona baixa de la pila.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green><bold>The team reached %1 m!</bold></green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green><bold>L'equip ha arribat als %1 m!</bold></green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Taser: right-click to toggle; chains drain faster.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Taser: clic dret per activar; els grups gasten més càrrega.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Collect your glowing supplies during the break.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Recull els teus subministraments brillants durant la pausa.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red><bold>Wave %1:</bold></red> <white>%2 robots incoming.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red><bold>Onada %1:</bold></red> <white>arriben %2 robots.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green><bold>Wave %1 cleared!</bold></green> <yellow>Supplies are falling at the center. Wave resumes in %2 s.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green><bold>Onada %1 superada!</bold></green> <yellow>Cauen subministraments al centre. L'onada torna en %2 s.</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Right-click to connect nearby robots automatically.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Clic dret per connectar automàticament els robots propers.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Each linked robot uses charge; switch weapons to recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>La càrrega es gasta per robot; canvia d’arma per recarregar.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Taser L%1: %2/%3</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Taser N%1: %2/%3</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Taser L%1 active: %2/%3</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Taser N%1 actiu: %2/%3</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser Core</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Nucli de Taser</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Pick up to upgrade your Taser's charge, chaining, and recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Recull-lo per millorar la càrrega, els enllaços i la recàrrega del Taser.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser upgraded to level %1.</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser millorat al nivell %1.</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Your Taser is already fully upgraded.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>El teu Taser ja està millorat al màxim.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>TNT: blasts robots and lifts allies safely.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>TNT: destrossa robots i aixeca els aliats sense fer mal.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Too much TNT deployed. Recover or detonate a charge first.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Hi ha massa TNT desplegada. Recupera o fes explotar una càrrega abans.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Cutter: jump away before its saw cuts the scaffold.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Tallador: salta abans que la serra talli la bastida.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Compactor: dodge its slam; strike when its armor opens.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Compactador: esquiva el cop; ataca quan obre la cuirassa.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Wave %1: the Compactor!</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Onada %1: el Compactador!</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>The Compactor is overheating! Attacks come faster; warning time stays the same.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>El Compactador se sobreescalfa! Ataca més sovint; el temps d’avís és el mateix.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Compactor</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Compactador</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>You have 3 lives; keep your gear on respawn, spectate at zero. The team loses when everyone is out.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Tens 3 vides; conserves l’equip en reaparèixer i observes quan s’acaben. L’equip perd quan no queda ningú.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Jetpack: right-click to fly; land to recharge.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Jetpack: clic dret per volar; aterra per recarregar.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Next wave in</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Propera onada en</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Robots left</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Robots restants</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Lives: %1. Respawn with your equipment and keep climbing.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Vides: %1. Reapareix amb el teu equip i continua pujant.</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red>Lives: %1. You are now spectating; your teammates can still finish the climb.</red>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red>Vides: %1. Ara observes; els teus companys encara poden completar l’ascens.</red>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red><bold>The team is out of lives.</bold></red> <white>The climb ends here.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red><bold>L’equip s’ha quedat sense vides.</bold></red> <white>L’ascens acaba aquí.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Worker: slash it for climbing scrap.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Obrer: usa l’espasa; deixa ferralla per pujar.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Guard: carries a sword. Keep moving.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Guàrdia: porta espasa. Mou-te.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Springer: jumps onto platforms. Dodge sideways.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Saltador: salta a les plataformes. Esquiva’l de costat.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Gold Drone: dodge its fire or interrupt with the Taser.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Dron d’or: esquiva el foc o interromp-lo amb el Taser.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Iron Artillery: dodge its shots; aim with your bow.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Artilleria: esquiva els trets; apunta amb l’arc.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Heavy: tough armor. Use TNT or a sword critical.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Pesant: cuirassa forta. Usa TNT o un cop crític.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Overclocker: fast. Slow it with the Taser.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Accelerador: corre molt. Frena’l amb el Taser.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Scout: agile. Keep it away from your scaffolds.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Explorador: àgil. Allunya’l de les bastides.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Jetpack</bold></aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua><bold>Propulsor</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Right-click to toggle thrust; switch items to stop.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Clic dret per volar; canvia d’objecte per parar.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Three seconds of flight; land to recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Tres segons de vol; aterra per recarregar.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Jetpack active: %1/%2</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Propulsor actiu: %1/%2</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Jetpack: %1/%2</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Propulsor: %1/%2</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red>❤ Lives: %1</red>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red>❤ Vides: %1</red>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>One heart is lost on death.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Perds un cor quan mors.</gray>
